pmcp — the skills your installed packages ship

  serve        Run the MCP server on stdio (also the default for piped launches)
  list         List the skills discovered in node_modules and marketplaces
  index        Encode the catalog so ranking can be semantic
  models       List embedding presets without loading or downloading models
  login        Sign in on this machine, to obtain skills this project lacks
  logout       Forget the sign-in on this machine
  whoami       Whether this machine is signed in, and to what
  available    Find provided skills matching this project's installed dependencies
  preview      Show a skill's contents and a complete example
  install      Install matching skill npm packages with the project's package manager
  sync         Update declared skill packages without removing other dependencies
  project      Write each agent tool's native files from .agents/ and pmcp.toml
  doctor       Ask each agent tool, through its own listing commands, whether it loads this project's assets
  validate     Check skills against the Agent Skills specification: given directories, or every skill the catalog reaches
  mailbox      Manage opt-in local peer mail and launcher credentials
  harness      Manage optional owned native sessions independently of the MCP server
  tui          Open a native terminal workspace with optional configuration
  marketplace  List free public plugins or export a selected native plugin

  With no command, pmcp opens a terminal workspace on a supported TTY.
  Piped launches retain MCP stdio. Use pmcp serve explicitly for MCP.

  -q, --quiet  only errors
  --no-color   never colour output; NO_COLOR is honoured too
  --version    print the version
  -h, --help   this, or help for one command

commands.serve:
pmcp serve
  Run the MCP server on stdio (also the default for piped launches)

  pmcp serve [--root <dir>] [--scope <prefix>] [--marketplace <dir>] [--package <dir>] [--workspace <dir>] [--config <file> | --no-config] [--prompts]

  --root <dir>                    A node_modules directory to walk. Repeatable.
  --scope <prefix>                Only packages whose names start with this. Repeatable.
  --no-builtin                    Exclude the bundled free PMCP marketplace.
  --marketplace <dir>             An installed local Claude, Codex or Grok marketplace directory. Repeatable.
  --package <dir>                 A package directory read directly, for one no node_modules links; without a package.json its folder name is the package name. Repeatable.
  --workspace <dir>               A workspace root, or a glob of them: each root and every member its workspaces globs name. Repeatable.
  --config <file>                 A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one at or above the working directory.
  --no-config                     Ignore pmcp.toml; CLI defaults and the given flags apply.
  --model <name>                  Embedding preset or model ID; list presets with pmcp models
  --dtype <q4|q8|fp32>            Weight precision; uses the selected model default when omitted
  --dimensions <number>           Supported output width; uses the model's full output when omitted
  --model-revision <revision>     Model revision used for loading and index identity
  --model-path <dir>              Local model artifact directory
  --model-cache <dir>             Model cache directory
  --query-prefix <text>           Custom model's query instruction prefix
  --passage-prefix <text>         Custom model's document instruction prefix
  --pooling <mean|cls>            Custom model's pooling method
  --lexical                       Skip semantic index and model loading
  --mailbox-actor-file <file>     Private launcher actor credential for opt-in mailbox
  --mailbox-binding-file <file>   Private attachment file written by the launcher
  --mailbox-runtime <runtime>     Launcher-assigned canonical runtime
  --mailbox-replace-session <id>  Exact old attachment ID to replace
  --mailbox-native-session <id>   Launcher-owned native session ID
  --prompts                       Also offer one prompt per skill, for hosts that turn prompts into commands.

  --root <dir>         A node_modules directory to walk. Repeatable.
  --scope <prefix>     Only packages whose names start with this. Repeatable.
  --no-builtin         Exclude the bundled free PMCP marketplace.
  --marketplace <dir>  An installed local Claude, Codex or Grok marketplace directory. Repeatable.
  --package <dir>      A package directory read directly, for one no node_modules links; without a package.json its folder name is the package name. Repeatable.
  --workspace <dir>    A workspace root, or a glob of them: each root and every member its workspaces globs name. Repeatable.
  --config <file>      A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one at or above the working directory.
  --no-config          Ignore pmcp.toml; CLI defaults and the given flags apply.
  --json               Emit JSON rather than a table.
commands.index:
pmcp index
  Encode the catalog so ranking can be semantic

  pmcp index [--root <dir>] [--model <id>]

  --root <dir>                 A node_modules directory to walk. Repeatable.
  --scope <prefix>             Only packages whose names start with this. Repeatable.
  --no-builtin                 Exclude the bundled free PMCP marketplace.
  --marketplace <dir>          An installed local Claude, Codex or Grok marketplace directory. Repeatable.
  --package <dir>              A package directory read directly, for one no node_modules links; without a package.json its folder name is the package name. Repeatable.
  --workspace <dir>            A workspace root, or a glob of them: each root and every member its workspaces globs name. Repeatable.
  --config <file>              A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one at or above the working directory.
  --no-config                  Ignore pmcp.toml; CLI defaults and the given flags apply.
  --model <name>               Embedding preset or model ID; list presets with pmcp models
  --dtype <q4|q8|fp32>         Weight precision; uses the selected model default when omitted
  --dimensions <number>        Supported output width; uses the model's full output when omitted
  --model-revision <revision>  Model revision used for loading and index identity
  --model-path <dir>           Local model artifact directory
  --model-cache <dir>          Model cache directory
  --query-prefix <text>        Custom model's query instruction prefix
  --passage-prefix <text>      Custom model's document instruction prefix
  --pooling <mean|cls>         Custom model's pooling method
  --local-only                 Refuse model downloads
  --force                      Re-encode the selected model even when descriptions match
  --json                       Emit JSON rather than a summary.
  --dry-run                    Report what would be encoded and write nothing.
commands.models:
pmcp models
  List embedding presets without loading or downloading models

  pmcp models [--json]

commands.login:
pmcp login
  Sign in on this machine, to obtain skills this project lacks

  pmcp login [--issuer <url>]

  --issuer <url>  override the auth issuer
commands.logout:
pmcp logout
  Forget the sign-in on this machine

  pmcp logout
commands.whoami:
pmcp whoami
  Whether this machine is signed in, and to what

  pmcp whoami [--json]

  --json  Print the answer as JSON.
commands.available:
pmcp available
  Find provided skills matching this project's installed dependencies

  pmcp available [--project <dir>] [--catalog <file>] [--json]

  --provider <public|hosted>  Public free catalog (default) or explicitly hosted service.
  --project <dir>             Project directory containing package.json.
  --api <origin>              Catalog API origin.
  --catalog <file>            Use a saved catalog response without network access.
  --json                      Print machine-readable results.
commands.preview:
pmcp preview
  Show a skill's contents and a complete example

  pmcp preview <skill-package> [--json]

  --provider <public|hosted>  Public free catalog (default) or explicitly hosted service.
  --project <dir>             Project directory containing package.json.
  --api <origin>              Catalog API origin.
  --catalog <file>            Use a saved catalog response without network access.
  --json                      Print machine-readable results.
commands.install:
pmcp install
  Install matching skill npm packages with the project's package manager

  pmcp install <skill-package>... | --all [--dry-run | --yes]

  --provider <public|hosted>  Public free catalog (default) or explicitly hosted service.
  --project <dir>             Project directory containing package.json.
  --api <origin>              Catalog API origin.
  --catalog <file>            Use a saved catalog response without network access.
  --json                      Print machine-readable results.
  --dry-run                   Show the plan without installing or changing files.
  --yes                       Approve the displayed project and lockfile changes.
  --all                       Select all matching skill packages.

  --project <dir>             Project directory containing package.json.
  --api <origin>              Catalog API origin.
  --catalog <file>            Use a saved catalog response without network access.
  --json                      Print machine-readable results.
  --dry-run                   Show the plan without installing or changing files.
  --yes                       Approve the displayed project and lockfile changes.
commands.project:
pmcp project
  Write each agent tool's native files from .agents/ and pmcp.toml

  pmcp project [--check] | pmcp project add <skill|agent> | pmcp project remove <name> | pmcp project import-mcp --source <tool>:<file> [--name <alias>] [--write]

  --root <dir>            A node_modules directory to walk. Repeatable.
  --scope <prefix>        Only packages whose names start with this. Repeatable.
  --no-builtin            Exclude the bundled free PMCP marketplace.
  --marketplace <dir>     An installed local Claude, Codex or Grok marketplace directory. Repeatable.
  --package <dir>         A package directory read directly, for one no node_modules links; without a package.json its folder name is the package name. Repeatable.
  --workspace <dir>       A workspace root, or a glob of them: each root and every member its workspaces globs name. Repeatable.
  --config <file>         A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one at or above the working directory.
  --no-config             Ignore pmcp.toml; CLI defaults and the given flags apply.
  --source <tool>:<file>  Explicit native MCP source as <tool>:<file>. Repeatable; import-mcp only.
  --name <alias>          Import only this MCP alias. Repeatable; import-mcp only.
  --write                 Back up and import the reviewed MCP declarations; import-mcp only.
  --check                 Write nothing; exit 2 when an output drifted, went stale or is undeclared.
commands.doctor:
pmcp doctor
  Ask each agent tool, through its own listing commands, whether it loads this project's assets

  pmcp doctor [--tool <name>] [--json] [--memory]

  --config <file>  A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one.
  --tool <name>    Check only this tool (claude, codex, gemini, grok, antigravity, opencode). Repeatable.
  --json           Emit JSON rather than a table.
  --memory         Report native memory configuration metadata only; do not read memory bodies or check MCP connections.

  --workspace <dir>    A workspace root, or a glob of them: each root and every member its workspaces globs name. Repeatable.
  --config <file>      A pmcp.toml to read instead of the nearest one at or above the working directory.
  --no-config          Ignore pmcp.toml; CLI defaults and the given flags apply.
  --json               Emit JSON rather than a table.
commands.mailbox:
pmcp mailbox
  Manage opt-in local peer mail and launcher credentials

  pmcp mailbox operation [--config <file>] [options]

  --config <file>          Project pmcp.toml
  --state-dir <dir>        Private mailbox state directory
  --actor <id>             Registered actor ID
  --actor-file <file>      Private actor credential file
  --binding-file <file>    Private existing attachment file
  --parent-binding <file>  Live parent attachment for bounded child delegation
  --input <file>           Operation input JSON or backup source
  --output <file>          New export or backup destination
  --scope-actor <id>       Limit export to one actor's correspondence
  --operator               Explicit local administrator intent
commands.harness:
pmcp harness
  Manage optional owned native sessions independently of the MCP server

  pmcp harness layout | family operation [options]

  --include-starts     Include pending native starts in recovery inspection
  --columns <integer>  Terminal width in cells
  --rows <integer>     Terminal height including status
  --generation <id>    Expected group generation for a mutation
  --group-file <file>  Private owned group state
  --input <file>       Group, session, read or watch specification JSON
  --session <id>       Owned native session ID
  --lease-file <file>  Private writer credential
  --controller <id>    Local controller identity
  --mode <mode>        Control cli/native; attachment observe/write
  --request-id <id>    Explicit input idempotency key
  --text-file <file>   Literal single-line UTF-8 input without submission
commands.tui:
pmcp tui
  Open a native terminal workspace with optional configuration

  pmcp tui [--config <file>] [--runtime <id>] | plan | recovery | doctor | start-worker --runtime <id> | operation --view <file>

  --group-file <file>     Existing owned harness group
  --view <file>           Private TUI view state
  --columns <count>       Terminal columns (40–1000)
  --rows <count>          Terminal rows (12–1000)
  --index <count>         Worker dock index
  --memory-mb <count>     Worker memory reservation
  --confirm-session <id>  Exact target ID for stop
  --config <file>         Project pmcp.toml (or mailbox config for create)
  --runtime <runtime>     Native runtime ID for main launch or worker start
  --yes                   Confirm the first native runtime start
  --new                   Create a workspace after the previous group is stopped
  --actor-file <file>     Optional private mailbox observer credential
commands.marketplace:
pmcp marketplace
  List free public plugins or export a selected native plugin

  pmcp marketplace list | export <plugin> --runtime <runtime> --output <directory> [--json]

  --runtime <runtime>   Native plugin format: claude, codex, gemini, grok or agy.
  --output <directory>  New directory for the selected plugin; existing paths are preserved.
  --json                Print machine-readable results.
